in_sanskrit.name: गिरिनन्दन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is nurtured by the mountain; a reference to Lord Krishna as a child, who was fond of playing in the Govardhan Hill.

in_hindi.name: गिरिनन्दन
in_hindi.long_meaning: पहाड़ी से पलायन करने वाला या पहाड़ी का पुत्र

in_marathi.name: Girinandan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girinandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two Sanskrit words, 'giri' meaning mountain and 'nandan' meaning dweller.

in_bengali.name: Girinandan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mountain Dweller
in_bengali.long_meaning: Girinandan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two Sanskrit words, 'giri' meaning mountain and 'nandan' meaning dweller.
